scope: O1 six-round TCP main/pre/post comparison plus two descriptive UDP guard pairs after A+B cleanup. This evidence does not close the confirmed CPU regression.

statistics.TCP: Six same-seed rounds; each of the six permutations occurs once. Paired log-ratio t interval df5 for pre/main, post/main, post/pre; retain all per-round and relative-order values.

estimator.primary: measurement cgroup usage_usec delta / successful completions inside the measurement epoch
secondary: raw CPU total and busy fraction
estimator.estimate: geometric mean of six paired fix/main CPU ratios; 95% t interval on paired log ratios, df=5, t=2.570581835636305
estimator.diagnostic: all six pair values, median, AB/BA subgroup medians, and exact 64-sign-flip p on mean paired log ratio; p is descriptive only
decision: Lower 95% ratio bound >1: CPU cost increase confirmed for this Oracle workload, even if smaller than 10%.
Lower bound >1.10: increase above 10% confirmed; point estimate >1.10 without this bound retains magnitude uncertainty.
CI crossing 1 is unresolved, not proof of noise or no regression. Conflicting median/AB/BA groups require causal follow-up.
Upper bound <1.10 can bound this tested workload below the 10% scale, but cannot establish zero regression.
No W/range filter, no all-directions requirement, no pooling request samples as independent runs.
Intervals are per scenario and rely on paired log-ratio assumptions; not familywise confidence across three scenarios.
estimator.invalid_data: Never delete, retry, replace or select windows. Preserve behavior errors and method failures. Report all analyzable values; incomplete/invalid/generator-limited scenarios cannot close the performance question.

statistics.interpretation: post/pre measures the combined A+B change, not either change separately. post/main is current cumulative cost. Concurrent pre/main is a control and does not replace the original 36 windows.
statistics.UDP: Two main/post pairs in opposite order only; report both ratios and counts without inferential CI. A direct CNAME index check affects UDP too, so this is a guard, not a renewed broad performance-equivalence claim.
statistics.exclusion: No retries, W filter, direction unanimity requirement, removal or replacement. All invalid observations remain; invalid/incomplete comparisons cannot close the cost question.
statistics.DHCP: Not rerun: A+B are DNS lookup changes. Earlier long DHCP evidence remains scoped to its tested workload; no zero-regression claim.

secondary_analysis.scope: Post-run read-only secondary analysis of retained three-way primary windows; no new load
limits: /proc/stat is sampled within epochs and omits subsecond edge gaps; low steal does not prove causality.
cgroup total is primary; user/system decomposition alone does not identify function or syscall cause.

interpretation.post_main: Prespecified paired-log 95% interval is entirely above one: +6.3949% geometric mean, interval +0.4426% to +12.6999%, all six pairs higher. Mean absolute delta +2.340447 us/query. The smaller point estimate does not establish that the main regression has disappeared or is bounded below 10%.
interpretation.post_pre: Geometric mean -6.3022%, interval -19.5141% to +9.0784%; median ratio0.969094. Four of six pairs lower, but interval crosses one and relative-order subgroup medians differ. A+B combined improvement has a favorable point estimate but is not statistically confirmed; neither change is individually attributed.
interpretation.pre_main_control: Concurrent pre/main geometric mean +13.5511%, interval -1.6848% to +31.1482%, five of six pairs higher. This control has a similar cost direction but its own interval crosses one. It neither replaces nor retroactively invalidates the earlier 36-window confirmation.
interpretation.UDP_guard: The two post/main ratios are0.910832 and1.054375, opposite directions. No inferential interval was planned or calculated. These are guard observations, not proof of UDP equivalence or zero regression.
interpretation.CPU_split: TCP mean main/pre/post=36.254275/41.396761/38.594722 us/query. Post-main user delta -0.540583 and system delta +2.881031; cgroup total remains primary and this split is not a causal function/syscall attribution.
interpretation.host: No cgroup throttling; all ten-second idle CPU observations zero. CPU0 steal maximum0.05154%, any-core maximum0.05914%; boundary lag maximum5.321624ms and p95 send lag maximum90.962us. These observations do not prove cause.
interpretation.integrity: All22 windows retained, no retries, exclusions or substitutions. No concurrent tracing/build/test loads; no idle CPU subtraction. Traced follow-ups and the prior36 primary windows remain separate.

limits: Six paired TCP rounds; intervals are marginal per comparison, not simultaneous across all three.
Three variants differ in cumulative source and main uses static ET_EXEC versus static PIE for pre/post. Combined A+B effect is assessed, not separate causal contributions.
UDP has only two descriptive guard pairs. DHCP was not rerun for DNS-only A+B changes; earlier scoped DHCP evidence is not expanded.
No router CPU, saturation ceiling, rate sweep, long-term leak qualification or performance-equivalence claim.
